app.name: F1 Tracker Pro
app.description:
F1 Tracker Pro brings Formula 1 to your Homey in a way that actually makes sense.

Build Advanced Flows that trigger minutes or hours before every session — free practice, qualifying, sprint qualifying, sprint and race. A dedicated 'race finished' trigger fires as soon as the winner is confirmed, so you can automate race-day announcements or celebrations.

Dashboard widgets included:
• Flip-clock countdown to the next race
• Full season calendar with gold/silver/bronze podium badges
• Driver and constructor championship standings
• Visual podium widgets for the top 3

All race data is automatically synced to Homey Logic variables so you can build custom tiles for every round in the season.

Supports English and Dutch. Race data provided by Jolpica (Ergast-compatible API).

Made by Mark — https://www.byhim.nl
